description_and_problem_statement: Retailers often miss opportunities to drive foot traffic and impulse purchases because they lack a mechanism to engage customers with relevant offers when they are physically near a store. An agent triggers personalized offers to a customer's mobile app when they are detected near a store location. The offers are tailored based on the customer's purchase history and the time of day, creating timely, relevant incentives that increase store visits and sales.
industry_pillar: Leverage AI to transform data into value
associated_horizontal_plays: AI -Your Business. Your Models - Vertex AI Platform -Growth
key_personas: Chief Marketing Officer, VP of Ecommerce, Head of Customer Experience, Chief Data Officer, Marketing Director, Product Manager of Digital Experience, Chief Digital Officer
customer_user_journeys: As a Customer, I want to receive a relevant, valuable offer on my phone when I'm near a store, making my shopping trip easier and more affordable. As a Head of Retail Operations, I want to use location-based offers to drive incremental foot traffic into my stores and create a seamless bridge between the digital and physical shopping experience.
how_it_works_narrative: This solution uses Google Maps Platform APIs to create geofences around physical stores. When a mobile app user enters a geofence, a Cloud Function is triggered. This function calls a Vertex AI model to generate a personalized offer based on the user's purchase history in BigQuery, driving immediate foot traffic.
google_proof_points: A large coffee chain uses Google Cloud to power its mobile app. When a loyalty member who has opted-in to location sharing comes within a certain radius of a store (a geofence)
Cloud Functions triggers a check against their purchase history in BigQuery. If they're a frequent buyer of a certain drink
a Vertex AI model might generate a personalized "20% off your favorite latte" push notification to drive foot traffic.
value_narrative: Uses location-based data and real-time infrastructure to send relevant, personalized mobile offers when a customer is near a store, driving incremental foot traffic and bridging the digital and physical shopping experience.
google_differentiation: Mastery of Geospatial Data and Real-Time Infrastructure: Google has unparalleled expertise in location and geospatial data, stemming from Google Maps. Retailers can leverage services like Google Maps Platform for geofencing, combined with our low-latency infrastructure (Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Vertex AI) to process real-time location signals and trigger personalized actions. This deep integration with a leading mapping platform is a unique and powerful differentiator.
